properties.qualifying_rule: kWp >= 10 summed per building (geb_id), not per facet; north-facing pitched roof faces excluded, flat roofs always count
properties.qualifying_rule_sentence: North-facing roof faces are excluded. Flat roofs count, since panels on them are angled south.
properties.battery_potential_formula: roof potential (kWp) x 1.5 kWh/kWp, HTW Berlin sizing recommendation
